items.title: PPL Stock Trading at a Premium to the Industry at 16.83X: How to Play?
items.summary: PPL trades at a premium valuation despite recent share weakness, while rising data center demand and a $25B investment plan fuel its long-term growth outlook.

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like PPL Corporation Stock?
items.summary: Despite underperforming the broader market over the past year, PPL Corporation continues to attract strong optimism from Wall Street analysts regarding its growth prospects.

items.title: CWCO Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Services & Manufacturing Weakness
items.summary: Consolidated Water's Q3 earnings and revenues miss estimates as services and manufacturing slump, despite bulk water growth and new project wins.

items.title: Can Alliant Energy's Expanded Capital Plan Drive Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: LNT's $15.9B capital plan targets rising data-center demand, grid upgrades and energy expansion, supporting 8% annual earnings growth through 2030.

items.title: Can PPL's Expanded Investment Plan Accelerate Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: PPL's $25 billion investment plan targets grid upgrades, new power generation and 10% annual rate-base growth, supporting 7-9% earnings growth through 2030.

items.title: Is It Worth Investing in PPL (PPL) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), PPL (PPL) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: PPL increases capital plan to $25B with proposed Kentucky gas plant
items.summary: The company projects some 50 GW of potential load growth, mostly from data centers, across Kentucky and Pennsylvania. CEO Vincent Sorgi suggested those states could see a influx of projects due to restrictions in other regions.

items.title: PPL Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Higher Growth and Data Center Demand
items.summary: PPL raises its long-term earnings growth target to 7-9%, backed by a $25 billion capital plan and rising data center demand in Pennsylvania and Kentucky.
